newsitem.title: USA: Zenith starts set top delivery to Americast.
newsitem.headline: Zenith starts set top delivery to Americast.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Wednesday it had begun delivering digital set top boxes to Americast, a group of telephone and entertainment companies planning to deliver television services.
In August, Zenith agreed to deliver at least three million of the set top devices to Americast in a deal valued at over $1.0 billion, the company said.

"This a major milestone," William Luehrs, president of Zenith Network Systems, said. "In 90 days to the day after signing the contract, the first of these digital terminals (are rolling) off our production line."

Initial quantities for Americast's technical evaluation are scheduled for delivery later this month. The digital set top terminals are based on open industry standards. Their design uses interchangeable network interface modules for four different digital video networks.
Zenith is producing the set top devices in conjunction with Divicom Inc, a unit of C-Cube Microsystems Inc.
Americast is a consortium of Ameritech Corp BellSouth Corp, GTE Corp SBC Communications and Southern New England Telecommunications Corp and The Walt Disney Co.
